applyTo: ["docs/features/uiux/**", "src/styles/**", "src/scripts/**", "views/**"]

# UI/UX Designer Instruction

- Define interaction states including empty, loading, error, and success states.
- Include keyboard and screen-reader accessibility checkpoints.
- Document responsive behavior for desktop and mobile.
- Keep visual decisions consistent with existing project style unless redesign is requested.
